body:
If I want to start and stop the clock, I HAVE TO DISPLAY (LARGE) controls at the bottom. This is infuriating. 

... as it shrinks the wheel of activiry, (what we love about timetimer)

Disappointed.

title: Fantastic concept—shocking execution
body: This is an amazing idea, I love their hardware products. This loaded once for me then just displayed a white screen after that. Even after restarting my iPad and re-installing the app. Really want this to work, but so far it’s bad.

body: This tool is so very well designed.  There is no better visual timer.  The original non-digital hardstanding device is excellent, and for on-the-go, the app is excellent.  Been using this for 15 years …
author: London771

title: Very useful.
body:
I really appreciate the repeat feature.  However, if my phone auto-locks, and I unlock to view the timer, the tone goes to silent.  I have to quit the app and re-open to restore the tone.  Inconvenient if on a repeat timer.

The workaround is I have to change the auto-lock time.

title: Really useful
body: Really useful to use this timer, particularly in the screen on mode so that I can see the time ticking down. I always have my phone on silent, so if it’s possible, it would be great if the alarm could override the phone silence option. Otherwise, I have to put sound on to hear the alarm and then might forget to re-silence before going into work. Minor issue relating to how I use my phone, but maybe I’m not the only one. Thanks for the useful app!

title: Super
body: I have the physical time timer clock as well and love it. This app is just like that but more portable. Glad to see it is ad free. Thanks!

title: Useful app ruined by the bell
body: I use this a lot for timing work sessions. But sometimes I can’t bear to wait for the notification sound. The beep is dreadful; the bell is the least jarring. I so long for something gentle or melodious.

title: Does what you’d expect it to do
body: Giving it one star because it is highly annoying that in 5-10 minutes of using the app it has asked to to rate it twice!
author: ConceptHobo

title: Wahaay. At last an update!
body:
Really useful, simple and great looking app. 
But why not let us start and pause the timers by tapping the huge, colourful circle rather than having to fumble for the tiny pause / play button at the bottom?
Eg tap once to pause / play tap twice to reset to the beginning.
Then it would be more or less perfect.

Update: Downgraded a star. There is a bug in this update. You can no longer alter a touch to set countdown timer until it has finished. If it pauses a model paused message appears right over the clock preventing any interaction. iPad version still works ok as they haven’t updated that yet!!
author: PapillonUK

title: One issue
body: Seems good so far except that the timer alert on Apple Watch doesn’t continue until dismissed (even though this setting is enabled in the iPhone app). One of the main reasons I downloaded... If that’s fixed then it’s a 5 star app.
author: Dungs go

title: Great app.....but
body: A great app that does what it needs to do but I'm not sure it is worth the price tag. For the price you would expect it to go that bit further. To return to the home page after selecting your chosen visual clock option and being able to notify you when the time has ended if you come out of the app. I've had to remove the digital displayed time element because it shows the wrong time. Shame because otherwise it is great.
